ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S5 Hybrid Tail Rescue is built on the S4/S1 JobGiver baseline for RimWorld 1.5. ThingRequest behavior remains unchanged: validated S1 large-search acceleration and S4 32ms Tail Rescue stay intact. S5 adds a narrow custom-search router based on S4-CD1 A/B evidence. Custom IEnumerable Thing sets with a directly available Count of 1-127 may enter the validator-first/live-CanReach fast path once the current JobPackage reaches 24ms. Known custom sets with Count 128 or more remain Vanilla even after S4's 32ms tail threshold, because CD1 measured a regression for that size class. Lazy or otherwise unknown-size custom enumerables retain S4's original 32ms rescue behavior. The original WorkGiver validator and live map.reachability.CanReach remain authoritative. S2 fanout, S3 learned admission, JR1/JR1.1 and CD1 diagnostic hooks are not included.
